basic_profile.bio: A curious engineering student from Seattle, currently in my first year of college. I have a strong interest in space technology and virtual reality, which is why I frequently browse subreddits like 'rockets' and 'ValveIndex'. I dislike negativity and try to stay away from heated discussions. I usually log in during late evenings after classes or part-time work at a local tech shop. I'm single and often spend weekends stargazing or gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Currently pursuing a degree in mechanical engineering. My knowledge in rockets and virtual reality is mostly self-taught through online courses, forums, and YouTube tutorials. I enjoy keeping up with the latest trends in tech and often participate in discussions related to space exploration.
